threads.body: `applyTo: "**/*.java"` causes these test-specific rules to be loaded for *all* Java changes, but the document says "Apply only to changes in test code." This mismatch can make Copilot apply test-only guidance to production code reviews. Either narrow `applyTo` to match the repo’s test/source patterns (e.g., `**/src/test*/**/*.java` and any other test-only source roots you want covered), or reword the intro to clarify that the file is loaded for all Java files but should only be applied when reviewing test code.
threads.hunk:
@@ -0,0 +1,66 @@
+---
+applyTo: "**/*.java"
+---
+
+# Java Test Rules (first-pass review)
+
+Apply only to changes in test code.
+
